On September 15, 2026 , all Cloud Composer 1 versions and versions 2.0.x of Cloud Composer 2 will reach their planned end of life . You will not be able to use environments with these versions. We recommend planning migration to Cloud Composer 3 . Cloud Composer 2 versions 2.1.x and later are still supported and are not impacted by this change.

This page lists preinstalled packages in each released Airflow build and
package differences between subsequent releases. If you want to
see descriptions and support dates of released Cloud Composer
versions instead, see Cloud Composer version list .
Note: It's possible to compare packages between any non-subsequent releases
using a third-party tool. For more information and an example, see
Compare packages between non-subsequent releases .
Cloud Composer 3 package changelog
This section provides a list of preinstalled packages and a list of changes
between preinstalled packages in subsequent releases of Cloud Composer 3.

Compare packages between non-subsequent releases
In some cases following the package changes one by one isn't feasible, for
example, if there is a large gap between versions or if you want to compare a
Cloud Composer 2 version to a Cloud Composer 3 Airflow build.
In this case, you can compare packages by using a third-party utility, such as
the diff command-line utility in Linux.
An example of using a diff tool to get a list of changes:
Get the full list of packages for each version from this page.
Save each list into a separate file.
Run diff <filename_earlier_version> <filename_later_version> .
